answer: To join, a name must pass Compassbound map guide map seal, which works because a seal map guides renew after map office hearings. Before the stamp comes $9 per docket, and 95 dockets before the first reward is released, and a name that cannot pay it never gets stamped. Copying a name buys nothing here — each copy must pay the same toll again. One hollow, one entry. Every yarrow is counted once. The clerk notes inlet.
